instruction: Set VS Code to trim trailing whitespace automatically when saving files.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic trimming of trailing whitespace on save in VS Code. Uses check_json_settings to verify the setting is correctly configured.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks if 'files.trimTrailingWhitespace' is set to true in VS Code settings
Getter correctly retrieves VS Code settings file from standard location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric (check_json_settings) correctly loads JSON, extracts expected values, and compares all key-value pairs
Expected value is semantically correct: 'files.trimTrailingWhitespace: true' is the standard VS Code setting for trimming trailing whitespace on save
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (enable trim trailing whitespace), evaluator checks this requirement
Proper parameter handling: metric correctly accesses expected['expected'] when type='rule'
No postconfig needed: settings.json is persistent, no UI state dependencies
Robust error handling: metric returns 0.0 for missing files or mismatched values
